- Initial release of AI Video Editor Gratis, version 1.0.0.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM footage (up to 500MB); process with AI-powered quick edits in the cloud.
- Describe desired edits (trim, transitions, background music, etc.) and export ready-to-post 1080p MP4 videos for free.
- Automatic session and token management: supports anonymous login with 100 free credits (7-day expiry).
- Includes workflow for uploading, editing, exporting, credit checking, and viewing session/video states.
- Handles common errors such as file size/type, token/session issues, and rate limits, with clear user feedback.
